description: A tulip-draped archway gate opens onto a petal-strewn path, garlands of pink and yellow blossoms looping between painted wooden posts, the whole entrance glowing softly in pale early-morning spring light.

A small bandstand wrapped floor to roof in cascading wisteria vines stands at the festival center, pastel bunting strung overhead in gentle scallops, loose petals drifting across the wooden stage floor in the warm midday breeze.

Long tables piled with loose peonies, ribbon spools, and fresh green stems wait beneath a canopy of overhead garlands, the blossoms tumbling softly together in shades of blush and cream, golden afternoon light pooling across the surface.

A ring of potted flowering cherry trees lines the outer edge of the festival grounds, their branches arching inward over a circle of woven daisy wreaths hung along a low wooden fence, soft morning mist still clinging between the trunks.

A poppy-covered archway stands at the far end of a petal-scattered lane, garlands of vivid orange and scarlet blossoms strung between tall wooden posts on either side, the whole corridor glowing in the slanted golden light of early evening.
